name: Economics Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Appraise (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Always Prepared (Ex)

You gain Brilliant Planner as a bonus feat. You do not need to meet its normal prerequisites, and your brilliant plan fund’s limit is equal to 50 gp for every rank you have in Appraise.

Associated Technique
Plundering Technique (Ex)

You gain a +1 bonus to your CMB on any steal combat maneuver checks made against a target you have studied with this ability, and you never provoke attacks of opportunity while using a steal combat maneuver against that target. At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +7 at 18th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Black Market Connections (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Always Prepared study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain the Black Market Connections rogue talent, except that you use Appraise instead of Diplomacy for all related skill checks.

Smuggler (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Always Prepared study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Sleight of Hand becomes a class skill for you, and you can use inspiration with that skill for free. If you attack with a concealed weapon, and your Sleight of Hand check beats your target’s opposed Perception check, then you deal additional precision damage equal to 1/2 your number of ranks in Appraise. This additional damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.

Stipend (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Always Prepared study ability, scholar level 2nd.

Your investments pay dividends. Each time you gain a level of scholar (including the level at which you select this ability), you receive a number of gold pieces equal to 200 × the number of ranks you have in the Appraise skill. At 8th level, your stipend increases to 400 gp/rank. At 14th level, it increases to 800 gp/rank. You can spend these funds as you see fit. The gold appears in a civilized, accessible location of your choice, or you can receive it as a part of your pay.

Waistband of the Wealthy (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Always Prepared study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You learn how to shape the Waistband of the Wealthy veil, and may do so with an hour’s meditation. If you do not have a veilweaving level from another class, use your ranks in Appraise as your veilweaver level and Intelligence as your primary veilweaving ability. You increase your total essence and the total number of veils you can have shaped by 1. When you reach 16 ranks in Appraise, you are able to bind this veil to your belt chakra slot.
